summary.text: Anna Dobie is the Family First candidate for Glen Waverley at the 2026 Victorian state election, as named on both the party's Victorian candidate list and the ABC election guide. Neither Family First nor the ABC had published a biography as at early November 2026.

summary.text: Brad Cox is One Nation's candidate for Glen Waverley at the 2026 Victorian election. His background, as the ABC describes it, spans running a small business, television production (including several national editions of The Amazing Race), content strategy and work with NDIS providers. One Nation's candidate page refused automated requests, so it could not be checked.

prior_roles.role: Producer, several country editions of The Amazing Race

sources.title: Glen Waverley: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Jacky Sun is the Liberal candidate for Glen Waverley at the 2026 Victorian election. An accountant, he has spent more than ten years in finance roles across global firms, listed companies and startups, and holds degrees in commerce and business law. He is a former president of the Chinese-Australian Multicultural Association and has volunteered as a Monash University career mentor since 2015.

priorities.text: Cutting crime and making local streets safer

sources.title: Glen Waverley: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: John Mullahy has been the Labor member for Glen Waverley since 2022, when the seat was created and he became the first Labor MP to hold it. Before Parliament he ran a small IT and telecommunications business and then worked as an electorate officer for Mount Waverley MP Matt Fregon. He is recontesting Glen Waverley in 2026.

summary.text: Nicholas Siow is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Glen Waverley at the 2026 Victorian election. A lifelong local of the area, he studied education and science at Monash University. He says he has been active in anti-racism campaigns and Palestine solidarity protests, and his campaign centres on housing, public services and opposing the far right.

priorities.text: fight for working-class people against the entrenched corporate interests
Reversing the decline of public services and infrastructure

sources.title: Glen Waverley: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Segar Nadarajah is the Labour DLP (Democratic Labour Party) candidate for Glen Waverley at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. A Segar Nadarajah stood as an independent in Tirhatuan Ward of Knox City Council in 2024, taking 7.2% of the first-preference vote; no source confirms it is the same person. The ABC had published no biography as at 9 Nov 2026, and the party's website would not load.

summary.text: Toyo White is the Greens candidate for Glen Waverley at the 2026 Victorian election. His work as a community-sector consultant has included projects for VicHealth and the Centre for Multicultural Youth, and he has been a youth projects officer at a charity. A lifelong Forest Hill resident and climate activist, he says he helped organise the Stop Woodside Monash campaign and has served on council environment bodies.

priorities.text: properly funded schools, real climate action and affordable renting and housing
